title: multi record refuses a replay's rows for the real results file even when --out names it
goal: A replay's rows never reach kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv: multi record refuses a replay whose --out resolves to the results file, as it refuses one with no --out (review of SP-5y4ut64g).

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
def clean(*dirs):
    import bench_multi
    for d in dirs:
        shutil.rmtree(bench_multi.clone_path(d, 1).parent, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
import hashlib
src = "kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv"
sha = lambda: hashlib.sha256(open(src, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
first = sha()
d = os.path.join(T, "r")
try:
    bench("multi", "run", "lookups", "--replay", "--dir", d)
    r = bench("multi", "record", "--dir", d, "--out", os.path.abspath(src))
    changed = sha() != first
    if changed:
        subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "--", src], check=True)
    assert r.returncode == 2 and not changed, (r.returncode, changed)
finally:
    clean(d)
